reason: The after-source contract supports DTD validation with external loading suppressed by XML_PARSE_NO_XXE. The old harness clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID before every parser route, so this supported combination is unreachable. The combination was unavailable before XML_PARSE_NO_XXE was added.
finite_witness: Input begins with option bytes 00 80 00 10 and allocation bytes 00 00 10 00, followed by URL `u` terminated by backslash plus LF, then `<!DOCTYPE r [<!ELEMENT r EMPTY>]><r/>` and 4096 trailing spaces. The internal DTD provides a valid document for the combined options; the harness removes the validation bit.

scope_contract.reason: XML parsing and its option bitmask are the entry's primary operations. The after contract defines both DTD validation and suppression of external loading.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry reads parser options and invokes XML parsing with them.

feasible_trigger.reason: Four input bytes can request bits 23 and 4, and the entity input format can supply a document with an internal DTD. The supplied padding makes the 4096 allocation value remain 4096 after the harness modulus.

evidence.dependency_reason: The helper reads the four option bytes.
The entry reads options, allocation bytes, and the main entity from input.
A URL and entity string become the main document.
Backslash plus LF terminates the URL; the remaining bytes form the entity string.

observable_consequence.reason: The parser derives validation state from XML_PARSE_DTDVALID, while XML_PARSE_NO_XXE suppresses external loading. Clearing the validation bit prevents the combined behavior.

evidence.dependency_reason: The new option blocks external subset loading even when validation is selected.
The harness clears DTDVALID before the pull parser receives options.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry passes the same masked option value to pull, push, and reader parsing and contains no call that restores DTDVALID. Other accepted option bits do not set the validation member in the supplied setter.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the complete entry, its mask, all three parser routes, and cleanup.

identity_preserved.reason: The assessed tuple is validation with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID while XML_PARSE_NO_XXE suppresses external loading. The before option enum lacks NO_XXE; the after enum and contract add that same combination, assessed against the unchanged old harness.

evidence.dependency_reason: States the after-source semantics of the same option combination.
The fixed harness masks DTDVALID for both source versions.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Accepts both bits and derives validation from DTDVALID.
The before enum has no NO_XXE option.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Selects the main document from the input entity pair.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Validate a document using its internal DTD with XML_PARSE_DTDVALID while XML_PARSE_NO_XXE suppresses external DTD and entity loading.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Pass both option bits to an XML parser with a valid internal-DTD document.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The input can request both bits, but the entry clears XML_PARSE_DTDVALID before all parser calls.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Validation with external loading suppressed is unreachable through this entry.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The complete entry has pull, push, and reader routes; each receives the masked options, and none restores validation.
